meta.title: Sidebar Organizer
meta.description: Organize sidebar entries, set shortcuts, and add custom links.

en.detectedCount: This session found {count} page(s) that need optimization.
en.displayFixHint: Detects pages whose title or controls overlap the window buttons when the sidebar is collapsed, then adds the missing safe-area spacing. You can disable it per entry below.
en.dragHint: Drag entries or links to customize order
en.empty: Drag here to move an entry into More
en.entriesHint: Change visibility and order. Updates appear in the sidebar immediately.
en.hint: Move any entry except Plugins into More. Drag to reorder, assign shortcuts, or add web links.
en.invalid: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL.
en.label: Link name
en.linkLimit: You can add at most 30 custom links.
en.linksHint: Add frequently used web pages. Links share the More order with sidebar entries.
en.peekHint: Hover the open-sidebar button to show the full sidebar while collapsed.
en.saved: Changes apply immediately and are saved on this device.
en.shortcutConflict: That shortcut is already used by "{name}".
en.shortcutHint: Focus the field and press a key combination. Backspace clears it.
en.shortcutLimit: You can assign at most 100 shortcuts.
